purpose: State-scoped Oklahoma 2024 source coverage inventory for result, review, turnout, map, historical, and election-administration context. This inventory records source availability and blockers; it does not promote production data and does not allege fraud or misconduct.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Oklahoma State Election Board official 2024 race-level CSV export
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: oklahomaRaceLevelCsv via civic_etl/native.py _oklahoma_rows and etl/state-configs/ok.json certifiedResults.raceLevelSourceId
caveats: Used to reconcile the county-level presidential export total before staging.
County result rows remain the map and certified-results display grain.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Oklahoma State Election Board official 2024 county-level CSV ZIP export
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: oklahomaCountyLevelCsvZip via civic_etl/native.py _oklahoma_rows and etl/state-configs/ok.json certifiedResults
caveats: County rows are the certified presidential result rows used for current public map joins.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Oklahoma State Election Board official 2024 precinct-level CSV ZIP export
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: oklahomaPrecinctLevelCsvZip via civic_etl/native.py _oklahoma_rows and etl/state-configs/ok.json reviewCharts
caveats: The comparison contest is U.S. House by district, not a single statewide race.
Only precincts with both Democratic and Republican U.S. House candidate votes are comparable down-ballot rows; other nonzero presidential precincts remain vote-share-only rows.
Precinct boundary geometry is not loaded, so subcounty review rows are graph/table inputs rather than map polygons.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: U.S. EAC 2024 EAVS V2 Oklahoma jurisdiction turnout fallback
caveats: Fallback turnout rows are official EAC context, not Oklahoma-native turnout or voter-history rows.
They do not share the same precinct grain as the OK review rows.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: MESA Current Registration Statistics by District 11/1/2024
caveats: The PDF provides registered-voter denominator rows only; it does not provide ballots-cast, voter-history, or voter-participation rows.
County rows are aggregated from congressional-district county fragments before use as denominator provenance.
Active turnout remains the EAC fallback until an Oklahoma-native ballots-cast or voter-participation artifact is collected and reconciled.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: U.S. Census TIGERweb Oklahoma county geography
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: censusTigerwebCountyGeojson via map geometry validators and public map joins
caveats: County geometry supports county result maps only; precinct boundary geometry is not loaded.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Verified Voting Verifier Oklahoma 2024 equipment context
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: verifiedVotingEquipment via data/admin-source-packages.json and equipment context scripts
caveats: Equipment context is supplemental administration metadata only, not a vote, turnout, audit, incident, or precinct-uniformity source.
County rows can summarize mixed standard, accessible, absentee, tabulation, or poll-book configurations.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Official 2016 General Election CountyResults CSV ZIP export
caveats: The export contains three presidential tickets across 77 counties.
Candidate totals exclude blank, undervote, and overvote records.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Official 2020 General Election CountyResults CSV ZIP export
caveats: The export contains six presidential tickets across 77 counties: Democratic, Republican, Libertarian, and three independent tickets.
All non-Democratic/non-Republican candidate votes are retained as Other; candidate totals exclude blank, undervote, and overvote records.

caveats: Rows are contextual historical baselines and not 2024 certified-result rows.
Official 2012 Oklahoma county history remains uncollected.

resultExports.finding: The official 2024 November General Election page links to the OK Election Results page and states that county, race, and precinct-level downloads are available from the export tab. The direct race, county, and precinct export endpoints are loaded in etl/state-configs/ok.json.

historicalBaselines.finding: Official 2016 and 2020 CountyResults ZIP exports are retained and normalized to 77 canonical county tags per year. All presidential candidates are included; 2020 has six tickets, not three.
historicalBaselines.caveat: The public results application exchange used a short-lived bearer token entirely in memory; embedded public-app values and the token were neither logged nor persisted. Official 2012 county history remains uncollected. Historical jurisdiction names use canonical Census display names while local_unit preserves export labels; county:40079 normalizes LEFLORE to Le Flore County.
historicalBaselines.requestNeed: Collect an official 2012 county-level President export or canvass artifact and add it through the same canonical county-tag path.

stateNativeTurnout.finding: The official Nov. 1, 2024 Oklahoma State Election Board voter-registration PDF was collected and parsed into 77 county denominator-lead rows. Its statewide registered-voter total, 2,442,211, matches the active EAC fallback registered-voter denominator, with zero county registered-voter mismatches after county-name normalization.
stateNativeTurnout.blocker: The Oklahoma voter-registration PDF has no ballots-cast, voter-history, or voter-participation field, so it is not a complete state-native turnout replacement.
stateNativeTurnout.requestNeed: Official county or precinct voter participation/voter-history rows with registered-voter denominator timing, join keys, expected row count, and statewide ballots-cast reconciliation.

precinctGeometry.blocker: The Oklahoma State Election Board points district and precinct GIS downloads to the OU Center for Spatial Analysis data warehouse, but no precinct shapefile/GeoJSON or precinct-to-result crosswalk is committed.
precinctGeometry.requestNeed: Collect and validate official precinct geometry or a precinct crosswalk before claiming subcounty map overlays.

postElectionAudit.finding: The official archive records the November 5, 2024 General Election post-election audit window and links report/findings plus county/race audit lists.
postElectionAudit.blocker: No row-level audit selection, contest, discrepancy, county/race, or finding artifacts are committed or normalized in this branch.

recordsRequests.requestNeed: Use the State Election Board records request path for records not already published, and county election boards when the record custodian is local.

cvrRecountsIncidentsCorrectionsLitigatio.requestNeed: Official CVR availability records, recount records, incident/correction notices, and litigation/election-contest records must be collected or requested before normalized rows can be loaded.

remainingGaps: state-native ballots-cast or voter-history rows that can pair with the collected Nov. 1, 2024 registered-voter denominator lead
official precinct boundary geometry or precinct-to-result crosswalk
normalized post-election audit selection/outcome rows from the official archive documents
CVR availability, recount, incident, correction, and litigation records
official 2012 county presidential baseline artifact and normalization
advisoryUseCaveat: Oklahoma advisory indicators are source/data reconciliation signals only. They are not proof of fraud or misconduct and require source, demographic, contest, turnout, equipment, audit, and custody context before interpretation.
